minutes.headline: Water commissioners posted annual meeting articles, including a non-binding straw poll on Arrow Estates water talks.
minutes.summary: The Water District commissioners approved prior minutes and the articles for the March 27 annual meeting. Public comment centred on Article 7, an advisory question on whether commissioners should continue discussions with the Arrow Estates owner about water on Howard Street. Residents questioned legal obligation, possible need for legislation, and the purpose of the poll.

Asked what happens if the non-binding advisory article is voted down and how it relates to the annual meeting.
Asked when the annual meeting is held, when the warrant closes, and whether a district member could bring an article.

Residents asked whether the district has a legal obligation to supply water to a property that would redistribute it, and whether legislation is needed to serve outside the district.

why_it_matters: Article 7 is an advisory question on whether commissioners keep talking with the Arrow Estates owner about water on Howard Street. It does not bind the district, but it shows commissioners how district voters feel before any commitment to extend service.
The legal-obligation and legislation questions were raised in public comment and not answered in the minutes, so the poll may be held before they are settled.
